info.name: Flying Angels - Updated Sprint 3 invitations and Athlete accounts
info.description:
Local-only email activation demonstration. Start the mail Compose profile. Uses Mailpit to capture messages for synthetic example.test accounts. Leaves an inactive account/category after cleanup.

Run every numbered folder in order from 00 - Admin sign-in and athlete setup, one iteration. Generated fixture IDs are validated and saved automatically. Missing fixture values stop the run before an invalid URL is sent; failed fixture creation stops the run at its source. Role/authentication, CORS and CSRF rejection tests retain their expected negative responses.

Invitations are queued durably. Mailpit search steps poll for asynchronous delivery; configurable mailPollAttempts (default 40) and mailPollDelayMs (default 500) bound the wait.
